owner: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / NIC Open Government Data platform
access_method: OGD API (api.data.gov.in) with a registered API key, or manual ZIP/CSV download by a signed-in user.
robots_txt: www.data.gov.in: "User-agent: * / Disallow: /" (all crawling disallowed). www.mca.gov.in: 403 (Akamai) to automated clients.
terms_summary: Government Open Data Licence – India (GODL): reuse incl. commercial with attribution (verify licence field of the specific resource on data.gov.in).
attribution: Source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs via data.gov.in, <resource URL>, accessed <date>, GODL-India.
rate_limit_policy: API key quota; unauthenticated/shared sample key heavily throttled.
known_gaps: Not acquired: robots.txt disallows www.data.gov.in and api.data.gov.in reset connections from this environment.
Needs an OGD API key (user registration) and a run from an Indian/GCP asia-south1 egress, or a manual download.
MCA detailed filings (directors, charges, financials) require MCA21 login/payment — out of scope.

owner: Securities and Exchange Board of India
access_method: HTML listings (session + the page's own pagination endpoint), order detail pages, order PDFs.
terms_summary: No reuse licence published; public statutory orders. Attribute SEBI; check before redistribution.
attribution: Source: Securities and Exchange Board of India, <order URL>, accessed <date>.
rate_limit_policy: Single connection, >=1.5 s between requests per host, exponential backoff on 429/5xx, identifying User-Agent.
known_gaps: Currently a 10-order sample (SOURCE_ITEM_CAPS); full index is ~24.5k orders — raise the cap to collect all.
Interim/ex-parte orders and settlements are not findings; SAT appeal references are captured from listings when shown.

owner: National Stock Exchange of India / BSE Ltd
access_method: Licensed data products (NSE Data & Analytics corporate data feed; BSE datafeed) or written permission.
robots_txt: NSE allows crawling, but Terms of Use prohibit copying/storing content without written permission.
terms_summary: Content owned by exchanges; automated collection/redistribution requires licence.
known_gaps: Not acquired (brief: obtain written/licence clarification first). Email NSE Data & Analytics and datafeed@bseindia.com.

owner: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
access_method: Paginated HTML table of public announcements; announcement PDFs.
terms_summary: No reuse terms published; statutory public notices. Attribute IBBI.
attribution: Source: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India, <URL>, accessed <date>.
rate_limit_policy: Single connection, >=1.5 s between requests per host, exponential backoff on 429/5xx, identifying User-Agent. Server resets bursts — keep the delay.
known_gaps: Listing has no CIN; per-CIN claim pages exist (/claims/*/<CIN>) for later enrichment.
Also covers the brief's separate "insolvency disclosures" row.

access_method: Public JSON used by the press-release page (/umbraco/backoffice/api/PressReleaseApi/GetPublic) and PDFs.
terms_summary: Copyright policy: may not be reproduced partially or fully without permission; acknowledge source.
attribution: Source: Directorate of Enforcement press release, <URL>, accessed <date>.

Not acquired: server blocks automated access. Curate high-value orders manually (brief).

owner: eCourts Services / Supreme Court of India
robots_txt: sci.gov.in allows crawling outside /wp-admin/, but judgment search is CAPTCHA-gated; ecourts.gov.in has no robots.txt.

attribution: Source: Supreme Court of India / eCourts, <URL>, accessed <date>.

access_method: Press-release archive by year (page form) and press-release detail pages.

terms_summary: No explicit reuse licence found; public regulatory communications. Attribute RBI.
